name: Unlock Fishing With Vanya
summary: Finish the mentor route, repair step, and rod handoff before chasing locations.
steps: Meet Vanya through the early tutorial
Craft or deliver the repair kit step
Receive the fishing rod and hobby ticket
Catch one starter fish before leaving the route

name: Line Tension Practice
summary: Use the color rule until reel timing is automatic.
steps: Reel while the line is white
Slow down when the line turns yellow
Release when the line turns red
Practice on routine lake fish before using rare bait

name: Starter Lake Loop
summary: Run Meadow Lake, Forest Lake, Onsen Mountain Lake, and Spring Lake before rare routes.
steps: Start with Meadow Lake for Wels Catfish and Goldfish
Move to Forest Lake for Arctic Char and Pearl Mussel checks
Use Onsen Mountain Lake for mountain lake rows
Only use premium bait after the routine lake list is clear

name: River And Rainbow Route
summary: Use Giantwood River and Tranquil River, then prioritize Rainbow weather windows.
steps: Check Giantwood River for Huchen and Rainbow Trout candidates
Check Tranquil River during noon-evening windows
Move river targets into Fish Tracker
During Rainbow weather, stop routine farming and run rare river checks

name: Ocean Progression
summary: Separate coastal checks from Level 10 late-ocean targets.
steps: Start at Fishing Village or Zephyr Sea for coastal rows
Move to Whale Sea after the late ocean route opens
Save attractors for Swordfish, Tuna, and Hammerhead
Use Recipes only after checking whether cooking beats raw sale

name: Rare Fish Priority
summary: Treat rare fish as a tracked route with weather, level, and bait gates.
steps: Track Level 10 targets before spending attractors
Use Rainbow weather for Giantwood River and Starlight Sea
Check Secret Pond around midnight for hidden pond fish
Mark catches in Fish Tracker immediately
